newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs-Thursday estimate 110,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs-Thursday estimate 110,000 - USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog marketings Thursday were 110,000 head, compared with 94,000 a week ago and 100,000 a year ago.
Estimates include generally about 60 percent carcass base hogs. Barrows and gilts uneven, generally steady with midsession Tuesday. Trade was moderately active for moderate demand and offerings.
Sows: uneven, generally steady. US 1-3 300-450 lbs. 43.00 -44.00 43.50 -45.00

Note: Prices quoted represent sales of hogs averaging 73-74 pct carcass yields, with mostly 1.00-1.25 inches of last rib backfat and 47-48 pct lean. Special considerations and grade premiums not reflected in base prices.
